checks.detail: extrados wall 0.58 mm (16.7% thinner); ovality without a mandrel about 3.2% (typical acceptance 5-8%), lower with one
checks.source: Bend Tooling thinning rule; Tube Form Solutions: ovality = 0.7 x difficulty factor
